definitions.full: H88. Oboth אֹבֹת proper name, of a location ( water-skins ) station of Israel in wilderness Num 21:10 ; Numbers 34:43; not yet determined, probably on eastern skirts of Idumea not far from Moab; accusative to Wetzst in De Ct 168 Wêba , in the Arabah, but identification not probably; compare Di on 21:10 . אוד ( be curved, bent , also transitive burden, oppress , compare Arabic ).
